neighbours.label: the second token of Silicon Valley place names: Santa| Clara, Palo| Alto, Mountain| View, San| Jose (also Men|lo Park); not other San/Santa cities
fire: The chip maker has its headquarters in Santa Clara, not far from the airport.
She grew up in Palo Alto and went to school near the university.
The search company built a huge campus in Mountain View.
Their flight landed in San Jose just after midnight.
Rents in Palo Alto have doubled over the past ten years.
The conference will be held at a hotel in Santa Clara next spring.
He commutes by train from Mountain View every morning.
The new light-rail line connects downtown San Jose with the suburbs.
quiet: The shipbuilder has its headquarters in San Diego, not far from the airport.
She grew up in Santa Barbara and went to school near the beach.
The search company built a huge campus in Mountain Home.
Their flight landed in San Antonio just after midnight.
Rents in Santa Monica have doubled over the past ten years.
The conference will be held at a hotel in Santa Fe next spring.
My cousin Clara commutes by train with her friend Jose every morning.
The new light-rail line connects downtown Sacramento with the suburbs.

notes: Card: ' Jose' x13, ' Clara' x6, ' View' x5, ' Alto' x4. Probes: Santa Clara 0.90, Palo Alto 0.72, Menlo 0.69, Mountain View 0.54, San Jose 0.45; Santa Cruz 0.25, San Francisco 0.03, San Diego 0.01, bare Clara/Jose 0.06. A place cluster (South Bay) rather than one token.
